undefined_policy: Constant score-vector Spearman undefined; retain raw values and block full aggregate for that metric rather than drop scenarios

practical_pilot_flag: Official excess Spearman loss >=0.05 on both banks in both tasks, a descriptive design threshold not a validated physical-control margin
